title: Iteration 2: Jump
goal: Bug! The hero floats up forever. Fix the jump.
mascot_lines: Now we add the most fun part — jumping!
When you press a key, the hero zooms up for a moment, and gravity pulls them back down.
We only let the hero jump if they're standing on the ground, so they can't float in mid-air.
A really good jump feels snappy — quick up, slow at the top, fast back down.

tier2.rephrase: A jump happens ONCE per press. Pick the right description.

tier3.nudge: Jump is a one-time push UP. After that, gravity wins!

sandbox.hint: Ask: 'why does my hero float up forever?'
